metadata.task: 8. Port Safe Topic Behavior Harnesses to 2021.1, 2024.1, and 2025.1

coverage_policy.promotion_rule: Promote only after fresh 2025.1 active live topic evidence with payload identity, bounded wait, readback, cleanup, and source immutability proof. This plan and skipped collection do not count as behavior.
coverage_policy.structure_changed_scope_note: ak.wwise.core.object.structureChanged is present in the 2025.1 manifest and semantic references identify it as the primary 2025.1 hierarchy-change proof, but Task 8 is constrained to the deterministic legacy safe-topic set only. structureChanged remains excluded here to avoid broad/nondeterministic hierarchy subscriptions; future semantic coverage must handle it with its own bounded publisher/readback evidence.
